en.r: Natural Bridge State Park is a state park in Wisconsin, United States. It covers 2.1 km² and has been protected since 1972. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is a protected landscape, where nature and traditional human use coexist.

en.ff: The arch was weathered out of quartzite about 1.6 billion years old: its top is 35 feet up and its opening 25 feet wide.

pt.r: O Mill Bluff State Park é um parque estadual em Wisconsin, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 6,5 km² e está protegido desde 1936, sob gestão do governo estadual.
pt.h: Parque no centro-oeste de Wisconsin, perto de Camp Douglas, unidade da Ice Age National Scientific Reserve. Protege morros de arenito de 24 a 61 metros, antigas colunas marinhas formadas há 12.000 anos no lago glacial Wisconsin, marcos para pioneiros e para quem passa hoje pela I-90/94.
pt.ff: Dez morros com nome, íngremes e angulosos, diferentes do relevo arredondado do leste dos EUA.

en.r: Mill Bluff State Park is a state park in Wisconsin, United States. It covers 6.5 km² and has been protected since 1936. It is managed by the state government.
en.h: A park in west-central Wisconsin near Camp Douglas, a unit of the Ice Age National Scientific Reserve. It protects sandstone bluffs 80 to 200 ft high that formed as sea stacks 12,000 years ago in Glacial Lake Wisconsin, landmarks for pioneers and for today's travellers on I-90/94.
en.ff: Ten named bluffs, steep and angular, unlike the rounded terrain typical of the eastern US.

es.r: El Mill Bluff State Park es un parque estatal en Wisconsin, Estados Unidos. Tiene 6,5 km² y está protegido desde 1936, bajo la gestión del gobierno estatal.

es.ff: Diez cerros con nombre, empinados y angulosos, distintos del relieve redondeado del este de EE. UU.

pt.r: O Peninsula State Park é um parque estadual em Wisconsin, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 15,3 km² e está protegido desde 1909, sob gestão do governo estadual. Na classificação da IUCN, é um monumento natural: protege uma feição específica, como uma cachoeira, uma caverna ou uma formação rochosa.

en.r: Peninsula State Park is a state park in Wisconsin, United States. It covers 15.3 km² and has been protected since 1909. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is a natural monument: it protects a specific feature such as a waterfall, a cave or a rock formation.
en.h: Wisconsin's third-largest state park, with 3,776 acres and 8 miles of Green Bay shoreline in Door County; about a million people visit each year. The search for a park in the county began in 1908.
